subject: general
question: The addition of which of the following adds fizz to soft drinks?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Carbonic acid**__.

__
 
• **Carbon dioxide or CO₂** is filled in beverages like soft drinks to give a fizzy nature to the beverage.

 
 
• **The process of adding carbon dioxide gas to a beverage is called Carbonation**__.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Acids**
 **Details**
 
 

 Citric acid
 
 
 
• Citric acid is an organic compound with the chemical formula **HOC(CH₂CO₂H)₂.**
 
• It is a colourless weak organic acid.
 
• Citric acid is found naturally in citrus fruits,** especially lemons and limes**.
 
 
 
 

 Acetic acid
 
 
 
• Acetic acid is also known as ethanoic acid, ethylic acid, vinegar acid, and methane carboxylic acid.
 
• It has the chemical formula of **CH₃COOH.**
 
 
 
 

 Sulphuric acid
 
 
 
• Sulphuric acid, known in antiquity as oil of vitriol, is a mineral acid composed of the elements sulfur, oxygen and hydrogen, with the molecular formula **H₂SO₄**.
